approvedDirection: Use eight role-card visual languages as palette, material, light and mood references for article-specific subject illustrations. Never draw the creatures or characters, except when the article itself is about a role card.
assembly: Combine sharedPrompt, one style rolePrompt and the article brief. Role names label style sources only; the actual image subject comes from the article.
sharedPrompt: Create ONE finished Traditional Chinese blog article cover, landscape 8:5, 1600x1000 preferred. Use the approved titled 12-week article cover as a quality reference. Left 48%: huge sharp Traditional Chinese headline '{headline}' and smaller readable subtitle '{subtitle}', plus a discreet MERLE NOTES badge. Right 52%: a concrete scene or object from the actual article, illustrated with celestial depth, fine star-map arcs, tactile materials and the selected style's palette and light. Keep important content inside an 8% safe margin and readable at 320px. Correct Traditional Chinese only; no additional words. No creatures, animals, mascots, people, role-card UI, AI TEAM QUEST branding, fabricated evidence, fake interface, official logo, watermark or generic stock-photo look. Conceptual illustration, not a depiction of a real location or product UI.
articleBriefTemplate: Article core: {one sentence describing the article's actual subject and reader takeaway}. Depict these concrete subject elements: {2-3 objects or actions genuinely present in the article}. Do not invent evidence, outcomes, institutions, interfaces, or locations.
